target_claims.statement: Resolve P versus NP by either a uniform polynomial-time decider for a locked NP-complete language or a superpolynomial lower bound for an explicit NP language.

inputs: Retrospective theorem ledger, machine-and-encoding lock, and dependency gate.
checker_contract.acceptance: Admit a later packet only with exact finite encodings, uniformity, total correctness, bit complexity, and proof artifacts.
checker_contract.rejection: Reject finite examples, heuristic algorithms, restricted lower bounds, or barrier evasion as a terminal resolution.

claim_boundary: This pending packet registers the terminal target and its certification burden; it does not resolve P versus NP.
blockers: No terminal claim or complete checker packet exists.
reopening_conditions: Reopen after native migration and production of a scoped claim with exact proof artifacts.
